trace.final:
I rolled checkout-api back to v2.3.0 in all regions, and the service is healthy again. I also opened the SEV2 incident, INC-0001, which paged on-call.

- **Rollback:** v2.3.1 was failing health checks in us-east, us-west and eu-west, with an 18% error rate. v2.3.0 is the most recent release that was healthy in production. Its release candidate, v2.3.1-rc, was also unhealthy in staging. All three regions now run v2.3.0, and the error rate has dropped to 0.2%.
- **Incident:** The first attempt to create it timed out. The incident list was still empty afterwards, so I tried again with the same deduplication key, which means only one incident exists. INC-0001 says what failed, what I rolled back to and how the service looks now. It also says the cause of the v2.3.1 failure needs to be found before it's deployed again.
